label: champ_0110_rival_01
text: You remember how it all works, right? Once you\nget badges from all the Gyms...[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: champ_0110_rival_02
text: you get to throw down against the strongest\nPokémon Trainers around![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: champ_0110_chairman_01
text: Yes. You must face the Pokémon League.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: champ_0110_chairman_02
text: It is located to the northwest of Mesagoza.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: champ_0110_chairman_03
text: The Pokémon League is where Trainers are\nreborn as Champions—the greatest honor that\r\nthey might dream of.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: champ_0110_rival_03
text: Collecting eight Gym Badges sets you up to\ntake the Champion Assessment.[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: champ_0110_rival_04
text: If you can face the challenge of the final\nexaminer and win, you’ll become a Champion![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: champ_0110_rival_19
text: Just imagine how that moment would feel.\nTry getting into that Champion mindset![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: champ_0110_rival_05
text: Now, set your sights on reaching that big,\nimportant stage...and let’s battl—[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: champ_0110_chairman_04
text: Excuse me one moment.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

text: Let’s have us another fruitful battle![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: champ_0110_chairman_06
text: An amazing display of talent, even against one\nas skilled as Champion Nemona.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: champ_0110_chairman_07
text: That was a splendid match. I enjoyed watching\nvery much.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: champ_0110_rival_10
text: Now even La Primera thinks you’re one to watch.\nYou’ve got so much potential![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: champ_0110_rival_11
text: The way you’re going, I better watch my back![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: champ_0110_rival_12
text: Did battling in front of La Primera give you the\njitters, maybe?[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: champ_0110_rival_13
text: Well, I might’ve won, but it was obvious how\nmuch you’ve bonded with your Pokémon![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: champ_0110_rival_14
text: Y’know, since the first time we met, I’ve been\nweirdly sure of one thing...[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: champ_0110_rival_15
text: You’re gonna become a Champion—no doubt\nabout it, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: champ_0110_rival_16
text: The rest of these Gyms? You can take ’em!\nHundred percent, no problem![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: champ_0110_chairman_08
text: I agree. In fact, you should take this. Consider it\nan investment in your future.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: champ_0110_chairman_09
text: She shows you such support and friendship.\nOr perhaps...\c\nPerhaps she hopes you truly might rival her?[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: champ_0110_chairman_10
